title: A page of events
description: What GET /v1/events, and an agent's own events, answer as JSON: the events after the cursor, oldest first within each agent's log.

events.description: Each event's source names its agent, and its sequence its place in that agent's log. Where a log was trimmed past the cursor, a wardrik.events.dropped says so.

next.description: The cursor after these events, which ?after= reads on from.
